name: Maximum finite difference-over-sum exponent certificate
definition: Choose U containing 0 from the nonnegative integers, with 2 through 512 elements and max(U)<=1000000. Require |U-U|<2 max(U)+1. Maximize 1+ln(|U-U|/|U+U|)/ln(2 max(U)+1). The strict inequality is the hypothesis of the finite construction lemma in the cited paper.
solution_format: An object with set, a list of distinct nonnegative integer elements that includes 0.
constraints: U contains 0 and consists of integers.
The set has 2 through 512 distinct elements.
Let s=|U+U| and d=|U-U|, with all ordered pairs included and duplicate values removed.
Require the strict inequality d<q, where q=2 max(U)+1.
verification: The checker recomputes exact integer sum and difference sets, checks the strict d<q lemma hypothesis, and evaluates the objective using outward-rounded logarithm intervals. The lower endpoint is returned as the conservative maximization objective.
